messages:
maria: heads up — the wrapjob on shard-7 stopped with lots of InvalidCiphertextException errors during the rewrap backfill. we paused the job to avoid spiking KMS QPS. need advice on restart strategy + required RBAC/audit controls. job id: bj-2026-03-20-77

samir: can you paste a short log snippet and the exact KMS provider? aws/gcp/azure?

maria: logs (redacted):
```
2026-03-20T10:12:03Z ERROR wrap-worker shard=7 item=usr_1234 Encrypt failed: InvalidCiphertextException: ciphertext failed integrity check, keyId=arn:aws:kms:us-west-2:123456:key/abcd-ef01
2026-03-20T10:12:03Z INFO pausing backfill after 120 failures in 2m
```
we're on AWS KMS for this tenant. envelope format: v2 (AEAD + header with key_alias and key_version).

devon: ok. two things: 1) RBAC — give the batch-service principal kms:Decrypt,kms:ReEncrypt,kms:Encrypt limited to the specific key ARNs (no wildcard). 2) audit — ensure we log key_id and key_version in the job metadata, but never log plaintext or raw input.

olivia: for restart/throttle: don't blast KMS. suggest concurrency cap + token-bucket per-region + DLQ for items that fail >3 times. also checkpoint progress every 1k items so we can resume.

samir: i agree. also we should add a safety flag to the job that enforces a max KMS QPS of 50 by default. we can ramp up after a small pilot.

maria: +1. question: is kms:ReEncrypt available across clouds consistently? we have a mix (most customers on aws, some gcp). if behaviour differs, we may need provider-specific codepaths.

devon: ReEncrypt is an AWS API; GCP has "cryptoKeyVersion" rotate/transform via the EKM/crypto operations — semantics differ. plan: implement a thin provider layer: "rewrap(item, target_key)" that calls ReEncrypt for AWS, and does decrypt/reencrypt using service account for GCP/Azure with ephemeral permissions. keep audit metadata identical: original_key, target_key, key_version, operation_ts, job_id.

maria: from a compliance POV we also need to capture the IAM/ServiceAccount used for the operation in audit logs. can't have a broad role permanently attached.

devon: agree. here's a minimal IAM policy for AWS we can attach to the temporary batch role (only for the rewrap run):
```json
{
  "Version": "2012-10-17",
  "Statement": [
    {
      "Effect": "Allow",
      "Action": ["kms:ReEncrypt","kms:Decrypt","kms:Encrypt"],
      "Resource": ["arn:aws:kms:us-west-2:123456:key/abcd-ef01","arn:aws:kms:us-west-2:123456:key/abcd-ef02"]
    }
  ]
}
```
this policy should be attached to a short-lived role assumed by the backfill worker. record the role ARN in the job metadata.

kms-bot: Backfill monitor: job bj-2026-03-20-77 paused by operator maria at 2026-03-20T10:15:00Z. failures=128, paused=true 

samir: +1 on short-lived role. also add a KMS throttling handler: if AWS returns ThrottlingException or LimitExceeded, back off exponentially and lower concurrency. also emit metrics: kms_rewrap_qps, kms_rewrap_errors_by_code.

olivia: we should also avoid re-encrypting items with mismatched envelope schema. add a fast schema validator step: if envelope_version != expected -> send to manual review queue. avoids noisy failures.

maria: good point. also need to think about audit retention: compliance wants key mapping history for 7 years for this customer. store mapping (old_key_id, new_key_id, object_id, timestamp, job_id, actor_role) in our encrypted audit table (separate KMS key).

devon: ops checklist proposal (short):
- create temporary role with minimal kms perms + attach assume-role policy (duration 1h)
- add checkpointing every N items and durable cursor in db
- implement provider layer with AWS ReEncrypt + GCP/Azure decrypt/re-encrypt fallback
- add schema validation and DLQ for bad envelopes
- pilot on 1000 objects in us-west-2, monitor QPS/errors for 24h
- if pilot ok, rollout with concurrency throttles + canary percentage
- export audit mapping to encrypted audit table and snapshot to S3 with limited lifetime

maria: sounds good. who wants to own the pilot? i'll coordinate with compliance for audit schema. need runbook entries + playbook for failures (rollback map).

samir: i can own pilot infra. will create a RBAC change PR and a short-lived role with the policy above.

olivia: i'll add SLO guards and the throttle token-bucket impl in the job controller.

devon: i'll add provider layer + schema validator + metrics. also will add unit tests for envelope roundtrip.

maria: thanks. action items: @samir create RBAC PR, @devon provider + tests, @olivia throttle & checkpoints, @maria runbook + compliance signoff. aiming pilot tomorrow morning 09:00 PT. :thumbsup:

kms-bot: Scheduled pilot bj-2026-03-20-77.pilot starting 2026-03-21T16:00:00Z (UTC). monitoring channel: #backfill-pilot.

samir: PR opened: https://github.com/redwood-inference/infra/pull/432 — role arn: arn:aws:iam::123456:role/rewrap-temp-role (expires in 1h after assume). pls review.

maria: noted. will follow up with compliance and attach runbook draft here. thanks everyone. :white_check_mark:
